recA5BnM5umys9yRk.Body: Kyle and Serena Denton are community herbalists creating wild-crafted and organic plant medicines out of Milwaukee since 2015. I have used their teas and tinctures on an almost daily basis for years now. Kyle is a great friend of InnerVerse and has appeared on the channel more times than I can count. These products work, not in the allopathic "pharma-medicine" way, but in a terrain-support, consciousness bolstering plant-teacher sort of way.
recA5BnM5umys9yRk.Name: Tippecanoe Herbs
recA5BnM5umys9yRk.Offer Line: Use coupon code "innerverse" at checkout for a 10% discount!

recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.
recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Name: The Sonic Slider

recEBEDXpPbvCxQw5.Body: Melissa Kupsch is the Australian homeopath behind RMDY Collective and RMDY Academy of Homeopathy, and one of the clearest voices I know for homeopathy as true energy medicine. Her remedies work on the resonance principle, like cures like, where a matching frequency from nature is shown to the body so the vital force can recognize the distortion and resolve it. When Melissa joined Kyle Denton and me on InnerVerse, we explored the premise that spirit precedes form, and homeopathy demonstrates that principle as plainly as anything I know. RMDY makes quality remedies and first aid kits accessible, prepared with real care for who makes the medicine and how.
recEBEDXpPbvCxQw5.Name: RMDY Collective
recEBEDXpPbvCxQw5.Offer Line: Use coupon code "INNERVERSE" at checkout for a 10% discount!

recFdBmTf1pJJOP6S.Body: LotusWei provides amazing and transformative plant essence elixirs, using one of nature's most gentle and beautiful elements: the flowers themselves. Led by founder Katie Hess, LotusWei supports customers with diverse products that operate on homeopathic principles and energetic resonances. I use LotusWei Elixirs to give me an edge with psychic & energetic sensitivity, discernment, and life force coherence. In other words, LotusWei Elixirs help me be a better podcaster and Biofield Tuner. Benefits accumulate over long term use!

recMVdJjP2VZJyI2m.Body: Clive de Carle has spent decades researching high-quality natural health essentials, from magnesium and fulvic minerals to iodine, selenium, and vegan-sourced vitamin D. His supplements are formulated with a focus on bioavailability, so the body can actually absorb and use what you're taking rather than letting it pass through unused. It's a simple, no-nonsense approach to filling the nutritional gaps most modern diets leave behind.

A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Name: Chance Garton

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Why the Biofield Is Electromagnetic", "body": "Chance starts from what mainstream science already accepts: the body runs on electrical impulses, and electrical activity produces magnetic fields, measured around the head by magnetoencephalography and detected around the beating heart. Electricity and magnetism shape each other, so whatever influences the field around the body also influences the current inside it. He argues that sound carries a magnetic effect too, and points to the piezoelectric effect, by which bone and crystalline structures in our cells turn vibration into electric charge, as one way a tuning fork's sound can reach the body."}, {"title": "A Fork in the Field Starts a Feedback Loop", "body": "Clinical biofeedback uses sensors to show patients how attention changes their heart rate or muscle tension. Chance describes tuning as a simpler version of the same loop. When a fork passes through a spot of stuck energy, the practitioner hears the tone change, feels something in their own body, or simply gets an idea of what is there. The sound shifts the charge in the matching part of the body, the recipient's attention goes to that spot, tension lets go, and the fork returns to sounding normal. Eileen Day McKusick calls it a dialogue rather than a one way input."}, {"title": "No Secret Frequency Code", "body": "Asked which tuning fork frequency to use, Chance follows Eileen Day McKusick: Biofield Tuning does not assign set frequencies to set chakras or organs. A coherent tone held in a spot of resistance lets the body hear its own noise and return to what Eileen calls its factory settings. He waves off online claims that one number will unlock DNA, recommends the weighted Sonic Slider for beginners, and suggests a 174 or 222 hertz fork next, since lower forks are longer, louder, ring longer and feel more grounding."}, {"title": "A Life Story Stored Like Tree Rings", "body": "Drawing on more than 600 sessions, Chance describes the biofield as extending about six feet from the sides of the body and about two feet above the head and below the feet, holding a timeline from birth at the outer edge to the present right next to the skin. Dividing a client's age by six tells him roughly how many years each foot holds. A heavy, stuck spot around age twenty led him to a car accident with heavy bleeding, and a spot near the beginning of another client's life revealed a lost family home."}, {"title": "Why Repressed Emotion Costs Twice", "body": "Chance explains Eileen Day McKusick's point that a repressed emotion drains us twice: once for the energy of the emotion itself, and again for the wall that keeps it out of awareness. From a terrain view, a chronic symptom can mean the body lacks the energy budget to finish a repair. He frames hard emotions as polarized forms of useful ones, sadness as the night side of joy and anxiety as excitement turned negative, and argues that reclaiming that energy brings more awareness, more vitality and an upward spiral that steadies the people around us."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: What is your aura, and can a tuning fork actually read it? In this solo episode, Chance Garton explains how tuning forks find and release stuck energy in the electromagnetic field around the body, drawing on more than 600 tuning sessions of his own and the work of Biofield Tuning founder Eileen Day McKusick, author of Tuning the Human Biofield and Electric Body, Electric Health.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: From the electricity running through your nerves to the faint light your cells give off, Chance lays out why sound can shift the way energy flows through you, why your mind and memory may live in your field rather than your brain, and how your biofield stores your life story like the rings of a tree, with birth at the outer edge and the present moment closest to the skin. Real session stories show how a fork held in the right spot can surface a long forgotten memory, reveal a repeating life pattern, or release tension the body has carried for years.
